name: getMyTasks
description: Get the list of tasks assigned to the currently logged-in user. Supports filtering by status.

name: getUserScore
description: Get total points, performance score, current tier (e.g. Great, Excellent), and points needed for the next tier for yourself or another employee.

userName.description: Optional: Name of the employee or 'me' for current user. Defaults to current user if omitted.

name: getTaskDetails
description: Get detailed information about a specific task by its ID.

taskId.description: The ID of the task to retrieve

name: getUserTasks
description: Get the tasks assigned to a specific user. Employees can only see their own tasks.

targetUserId.description: The ID of the user whose tasks to retrieve

name: getUnassignedMembers
description: Get a list of team or department members who have no active tasks assigned.

teamId.description: ID of the team to check (provide either teamId or departmentId)

departmentId.description: ID of the department to check

name: getOverloadedMembers
description: Get a list of team or department members who have more active tasks than the specified threshold. If teamId/departmentId are omitted, checks across the entire organization.

teamId.description: Optional: Team ID or Team Name (leave empty to check all teams)

departmentId.description: Optional: Department ID or Department Name (leave empty to check all departments)

threshold.description: Number of tasks above which a member is considered overloaded (default: 5)

name: getUpcomingDeadlines
description: Get tasks with deadlines approaching within a given number of days.

scope.description: Scope of deadlines to check. Clamped server-side to what the user's role allows.

days.description: Number of days ahead to look (default: 7)

name: getOverdueTasks
description: Get tasks that have passed their due date and are not yet Done.

scope.description: Scope of overdue tasks to fetch. Clamped server-side to what the role allows.

name: getProjectStatus
description: Get the status summary of a specific project including milestone progress and task counts.

name: getTeamDashboard
description: Get dashboard data for a specific team — task stats, member workload, and progress.

teamId.description: ID of the team (optional — defaults to requester's team)

name: getDepartmentDashboard
description: Get dashboard data for a specific department — team summaries, throughput, and task status.

departmentId.description: ID of the department (optional — defaults to requester's department)

name: getOrgDashboard
description: Get the organisation-wide dashboard with overall task completion, active projects, and team summaries.

name: getWorkloadDashboard
description: Get the workload dashboard showing task distribution and member capacity.

name: getTaskCompletionReport
description: Get a report of completed tasks with scores, scopes, and ratings within a date range.

dateFrom.description: ISO date string for the start of the report window

dateTo.description: ISO date string for the end of the report window

assigneeId.description: Optional: filter by a specific employee

name: getProjectProgressReport
description: Get a report showing progress across projects — milestones hit, tasks remaining, and delays.

name: getThroughputReport
description: Get the department throughput report showing task velocity and completion rates.

name: assignTask
description: Assign a task to a user. HR can only assign to Employees. Requires confirmation.

taskId.description: The ID of the task to assign

assigneeId.description: The ID of the user to assign the task to

name: createTask
description: Create a new task in a project. Team Leads can only create tasks in projects they are assigned to. Requires confirmation.

projectId.description: The ID of the project to create the task in

assigneeId.description: Optional: ID of the user to assign the task to

dueDate.description: Optional: ISO date string for when the task is due

name: updateTaskStatus
description: Update the status of a task. Employees can only update status on tasks assigned to them. Requires confirmation.

name: bulkUpdateTaskStatus
description: Update the status of multiple tasks at once. Manager/Admin/Founder only. Requires confirmation.

taskIds.description: Array of task IDs to update

status.description: The new status for all specified tasks

name: deleteTask
description: Delete a task permanently. Requires type-to-confirm with the task title.

taskId.description: The ID of the task to delete

name: createProject
description: Create a new project. Requires confirmation.

managerId.description: ID of the user who will manage this project

name: updateProject
description: Update an existing project's details. Requires confirmation.

name: deleteProject
description: Delete a project permanently. Requires type-to-confirm with the project name.

projectId.description: The ID of the project to delete

name: createMilestone
description: Create a new milestone in a project. Requires confirmation.

projectId.description: The project to add the milestone to

name: addRemoveTeamMember
description: Add or remove a user from a team. Requires confirmation.

userId.description: The user to add or remove

action.description: Whether to add or remove the member

name: inviteUser
description: Invite a new user to the organisation. HR can only invite with the Employee role. Requires confirmation.

email.description: Email address of the user to invite

name.description: Full name of the new user

role.description: Role to assign. HR can only use 'Employee'.

password.description: Initial password for the new user

name: bulkInviteUser
description: Invite multiple users at once. HR can only invite Employees. Requires confirmation.

role.description: Role for all users. HR can only use 'Employee'.

name: resetPassword
description: Reset a user's password. Admin/Founder only. Requires confirmation.

userId.description: ID of the user to reset password for

name: deactivateUser
description: Deactivate a user account (they will not be able to log in). Admin/Founder only. Requires confirmation.

userId.description: ID of the user to deactivate

name: reactivateUser
description: Reactivate a previously deactivated user account. Admin/Founder only. Requires confirmation.

userId.description: ID of the user to reactivate

name: deleteUser
description: Permanently delete a user from the organisation. Admin/Founder only. Requires type-to-confirm with the user's name.

userId.description: ID of the user to delete

name: addComment
description: Add a comment to a task. Requester must have read access to the task. Requires confirmation.

taskId.description: ID of the task to comment on

name: searchUsers
description: Search for users in the organization by name or email to find their User ID.

searchQuery.description: The name or email of the user to search for

name: searchProjects
description: Search for projects in the organization by name to find their Project ID.

searchQuery.description: The name of the project to search for
